decisions.choice: in peace: safe and unharmed
decisions.reason: The word often means "peace", but here it means that Jehoshaphat came back from the battle alive and unhurt. It answers the end of chapter 18: Micaiah had said that Ahab would not return in peace (18:16, 26-27), and Ahab died at Ramoth-gilead (18:34), while Jehoshaphat, who had cried out and been helped by God (18:31), came home.

decisions.choice: his house: the king's palace
decisions.reason: A king's "house" is his royal residence in the capital, here in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: safely; palace
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "safely" for "in peace" so the point (he survived) is clear, and "palace" for the king's "house". Literal keeps both words.

decisions.choice: "en paz" (L); "sano y salvo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here "in peace" means safe and unharmed (meaning decision), the words of Micaiah's warning (18:26-27), which the Spanish there renders the same way.

decisions.choice: kwa amani (Literal); salama (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "In peace" here means safe and unharmed after the battle, which Swahili says with "salama", as the Swahili 2 Kings note sets for welfare.

decisions.choice: em paz (L); são e salvo (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "em paz", the word Micaiah used when he said Ahab would not come back "em paz" (1 Kings 22:17, 28 in Portuguese); Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m1) with "são e salvo", the phrase 1 Kings 22:28 uses at Balanced for the same promise, so the answer to chapter 18 can still be heard.

en.B: Jehu son of Hanani the seer came out to meet the king. He said to Jehoshaphat, "Is it right for you to help the wicked and to love those who hate {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? For this, wrath has come upon you from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Jehu son of Hanani went out to meet him. Jehu was a seer, a prophet who received messages from God. He said to King Jehoshaphat, "Should you help wicked people? Should you love those who hate {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Because of this, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is angry with you.

es.B: Jehú hijo de Hananí, el vidente, salió al encuentro del rey y le dijo a Josafat: «¿Está bien que ayudes al malvado y que ames a los que aborrecen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? Por esto ha venido sobre ti la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Jehú hijo de Hananí salió a su encuentro. Jehú era un vidente, un profeta que recibía mensajes de Dios. Le dijo al rey Josafat: «¿Por qué ayudas a la gente malvada? ¿Por qué amas a los que odian {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? Por esto {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está enojado contigo.

fr.R: Jéhu, fils de Hanani, est sorti à sa rencontre. Jéhu était un voyant, un prophète qui recevait des messages de Dieu. Il a dit au roi Josaphat : « Dois-tu aider les méchants ? Dois-tu aimer ceux qui haïssent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? À cause de cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est en colère contre toi.

vi.L: Giê-hu con trai Ha-na-ni, nhà tiên kiến, đi ra gặp vua và nói với vua Giô-sa-phát: "[Vua] có nên giúp kẻ ác, và vua có yêu những kẻ ghét {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chăng? Vì việc này, cơn thịnh nộ từ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [giáng] trên vua.

vi.R: Giê-hu con trai Ha-na-ni ra gặp vua. Giê-hu là một nhà tiên kiến, tức là nhà tiên tri nhận sứ điệp từ Đức Chúa Trời. Ông nói với vua Giô-sa-phát: "Vua có nên giúp kẻ ác không? Vua có nên yêu những kẻ ghét {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không? Vì việc này, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giận vua.

pt.L: E Jeú, filho de Hanani, o vidente, saiu ao encontro dele e disse ao rei Josafá: "[Devia você] ajudar o ímpio, e você ama os que odeiam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}? E por causa disto [há] ira sobre você [vinda] da presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

pt.R: Jeú, filho de Hanani, saiu ao encontro de Josafá. Jeú era vidente, um profeta que recebia mensagens de Deus. Ele disse ao rei Josafá: "Você devia ajudar gente má? Devia amar os que odeiam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}? Por causa disso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está irado com você.

decisions.choice: Jehu son of Hanani the seer: a prophet from a family of prophets
decisions.reason: Jehu son of Hanani had spoken the LORD's word against Baasha king of Israel (1 Kings 16:1, 7). His father Hanani the seer had rebuked Jehoshaphat's father Asa for relying on the king of Aram (2 Chronicles 16:7). A seer is one to whom God shows what he wants said; the title is used of prophets (1 Samuel 9:9).

decisions.choice: the wicked, those who hate Yahweh: Ahab and his house; love: friendship and alliance
decisions.reason: The words point back to chapter 18, where Jehoshaphat made a marriage alliance with Ahab and went to war at his side (18:1-3). "Love" here is the loyalty of allies and friends, and "those who hate" the LORD are those who reject him. The singular "the wicked" can mean the wicked as a class, but here it has Ahab chiefly in view.

decisions.choice: a question that rebukes
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "No": helping the wicked and loving God's enemies is not what a king of Judah should do.

decisions.choice: wrath from before Yahweh: anger that comes out from the LORD himself
decisions.reason: "From before" the LORD means that the anger comes from his presence. The prophet announces it but does not say how it will fall; verse 3 at once balances it with the good found in the king. Chronicles often shows the LORD's wrath coming upon kings and people who forsake him (24:18; 32:25).

decisions.choice: a prophet who received messages from God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "seer" the first time it occurs in this chapter, as 1 Chronicles 21:9 and 25:5 do.

decisions.choice: wrath has come upon you from the LORD (Balanced); the LORD is angry with you (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase "from before the LORD". Balanced says where the wrath comes from, and Readable says it plainly as the LORD's anger.

decisions.choice: "Jehú hijo de Hananí, el vidente"
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 16:1 (Jehú hijo de Hananí); "the seer" belongs to Hanani or to Jehu (meaning decision), and Spanish keeps the comma open to both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "el impío" (L); "el malvado" (B); "la gente malvada" (R)
decisions.reason: The wicked here is Ahab and his house (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Jéhu fils de Hanani, le voyant"
decisions.reason: The prophet bears the same name as the king Jéhu of the terms note, and French Kings already calls him "Jéhu fils de Hanani" (1 Kings 16:1); his father is the seer Hanani of 16:7.

decisions.choice: Yehu mwana wa Hanani mwonaji
decisions.reason: The prophet has the name of King Jehu (Yehu), and he is called by his father's name as in the Swahili 1 Kings 16:1; "mwonaji" is the word for seer, as the Samuel terms note.

decisions.choice: the seer calls Jehoshaphat "vua"
decisions.reason: As Hanani to Asa in 16:7: a prophet's rebuke keeps the respectful "vua" of the terms note.

decisions.choice: Jehu the seer rebukes the king in 합쇼체; "선견자" (R explains it)
decisions.reason: Prophets speak to kings in 합쇼체, as the terms note; his father Hanani spoke so to Asa (16:7).

decisions.choice: Jeú, filho de Hanani, o vidente; você (the prophet to the king)
decisions.reason: The prophet's name keeps the form 1 Kings 16:1 gives it in Portuguese (m1), and "o vidente" is explained at Readable in the words of 1 Chronicles 21:9. A prophet speaks to a king with "você", with a prophet's authority, as Elijah and Micaiah do in 1 Kings 21:20 and 22:28 in Portuguese; "o senhor" is for a subject speaking up to the king, and "tu" is kept for God's own words (21:12-15).

en.R: But you have also done some good things. You got rid of the poles used to worship Asherah in the land, and you have made up your mind to seek God."

vi.B: Tuy nhiên, nơi vua vẫn có điều tốt, vì vua đã quét sạch các trụ A-sê-ra khỏi xứ và đã quyết lòng tìm cầu Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Nhưng vua cũng đã làm được một số điều tốt. Vua đã dẹp bỏ các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra trong xứ, và vua đã quyết lòng tìm cầu Đức Chúa Trời."

ko.L: 그러나 임금님께 선한 일들도 발견되었습니다. 임금님께서 이 땅에서 아세라 목상들을 없애시고, 하나님을 찾으려고 마음을 정하셨기 때문입니다."
ko.B: 그러나 임금님께는 선한 점도 있습니다. 임금님께서 이 땅에서 아세라 목상들을 없애시고, 하나님을 찾기로 마음을 굳히셨기 때문입니다."
ko.R: 그러나 임금님께서는 좋은 일도 하셨습니다. 임금님께서는 이 땅에서 아세라 여신을 섬기는 목상들을 없애셨고, 하나님을 찾기로 마음먹으셨습니다."

pt.L: Mas foram achadas em você coisas boas, pois você eliminou da terra os postes de Aserá e dispôs o seu coração a buscar a Deus."
pt.B: Mas há algo de bom em você, pois você livrou a terra dos postes de Aserá e decidiu de coração buscar a Deus."
pt.R: Mas você também fez algumas coisas boas. Você acabou com os postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá na terra, e decidiu buscar a Deus."

decisions.choice: but: the good is set against the rebuke
decisions.reason: The word marks a strong contrast. The wrath of verse 2 is real, yet the prophet also names what is good in the king.

decisions.choice: removed: cleared away completely
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn or sweep away, to clear something out entirely. 17:6 tells how Jehoshaphat took the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

decisions.choice: the Asherahs: wooden poles or images used in the worship of the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: Asherah was a Canaanite goddess. Her worship used wooden poles or carved images set up near altars, which the law commanded Israel to cut down (Deuteronomy 7:5; 16:21). The form used here is a plural not found in Kings.

decisions.choice: set your heart to seek God: made a firm decision to turn to God and follow him
decisions.reason: To "set" or "make ready" the heart is to fix one's will on something. Seeking God, turning to him in worship and obedience, is a key theme of Chronicles (15:2, 12; 17:4).

decisions.choice: made up your mind
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of setting the heart as making up one's mind.

decisions.choice: os postes de Aserá (L, B); os postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá (R); buscar a Deus; dispôs o seu coração a buscar (L), decidiu de coração buscar (B)
decisions.reason: As Judges 6:25 and 1 Kings 14:15 in Portuguese: "os postes de Aserá" at Literal and Balanced, explained at Readable as the English does (m3). "Buscar" is the Chronicler's word for seeking God (m4), as 1:5 sets it for the book. The idiom of setting the heart keeps the wording of 11:16 in Portuguese at Literal and Balanced.

records.literal_gloss: And dwelt Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem, and he returned and went out among the people from Beersheba to [the] hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to Yahweh, [the] God of their fathers.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem. And he went out again among the people, from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and he brought them back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their fathers.
en.B: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but once more he went out among the people, from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim. He brought them back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, their ancestors' God.
en.R: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem. But he went out once more among the people, from Beersheba in the far south to the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He brought them back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God their ancestors had worshiped.

es.L: Y habitó Josafat en Jerusalén. Y volvió a salir entre el pueblo, desde Beerseba hasta la región montañosa de Efraín, y los hizo volver {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus padres.
es.B: Josafat vivía en Jerusalén, pero salió otra vez entre el pueblo, desde Beerseba hasta la región montañosa de Efraín. Los hizo volver {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus antepasados.
es.R: Josafat vivía en Jerusalén. Pero salió una vez más entre el pueblo, desde Beerseba en el extremo sur hasta la región montañosa de Efraín en el norte. Hizo que volvieran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios a quien sus antepasados habían adorado.

fr.L: Et Josaphat habita à Jérusalem. Et il sortit de nouveau parmi le peuple, depuis Beer-Shéba jusqu’à la montagne d’Éphraïm, et il les ramena {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères.
fr.B: Josaphat habitait à Jérusalem, mais il sortit encore une fois parmi le peuple, depuis Beer-Shéba jusqu’à la montagne d’Éphraïm. Il les ramena {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres.
fr.R: Josaphat habitait à Jérusalem. Mais il est encore une fois allé parmi le peuple, depuis Beer-Shéba, tout au sud, jusqu’à la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm, au nord. Il les a ramenés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu que leurs ancêtres avaient adoré.

sw.L: Yehoshafati akakaa Yerusalemu. Akatoka tena kati ya watu, tangu Beer-sheba mpaka nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, akawarudisha kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zao.
sw.B: Yehoshafati alikaa Yerusalemu, lakini alitoka tena kwenda kati ya watu, tangu Beer-sheba mpaka nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Akawarudisha kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.
sw.R: Yehoshafati aliishi Yerusalemu. Lakini alitoka tena kwenda kati ya watu, tangu Beer-sheba upande wa kusini kabisa mpaka nchi ya milima ya Efraimu upande wa kaskazini. Akawarudisha kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu ambaye babu zao walimwabudu.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát ở tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Rồi vua lại đi ra giữa dân chúng, từ Bê-e-Sê-ba đến vùng đồi núi Ép-ra-im, và đem họ trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát ở tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, nhưng vua lại đi ra giữa dân chúng một lần nữa, từ Bê-e-Sê-ba đến vùng đồi núi Ép-ra-im. Vua đem họ trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Nhưng vua lại đi ra giữa dân chúng một lần nữa, từ Bê-e-Sê-ba ở tận phía nam đến vùng đồi núi Ép-ra-im ở phía bắc. Vua đem họ trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời mà tổ tiên họ đã thờ phượng.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 예루살렘에 살았다. 그리고 그가 다시 브엘세바에서 에브라임 산지까지 백성 가운데로 나가서, 그들을 그들 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오게 했다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 예루살렘에 살았지만, 다시 브엘세바에서 에브라임 산지까지 백성 가운데로 나가서 그들을 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오게 했다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 예루살렘에 살았다. 그러나 그는 다시 남쪽 끝 브엘세바에서 북쪽 에브라임 산지까지 백성 가운데로 나갔다. 그리고 그들이 조상들이 섬기던 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오게 했다.

pt.L: E Josafá habitou em Jerusalém. E voltou a sair entre o povo, desde Berseba até a região montanhosa de Efraim, e os fez voltar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais.
pt.B: Josafá morava em Jerusalém, mas saiu mais uma vez entre o povo, desde Berseba até a região montanhosa de Efraim, e o trouxe de volta {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados.
pt.R: Josafá morava em Jerusalém. Mas ele saiu mais uma vez para visitar o povo, desde Berseba, no extremo sul, até a região montanhosa de Efraim, no norte. Ele levou o povo a voltar para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus que os seus antepassados adoravam.

decisions.choice: returned and went out: went out again
decisions.reason: Two verbs joined together, "returned" and "went out", express one action done a second time. He had gone among the people before, when he sent officials and Levites to teach in the towns of Judah (17:7-9).

decisions.choice: from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim: the whole kingdom of Judah
decisions.reason: Beersheba lay at the southern edge of the land, and the hill country of Ephraim began at Judah's northern border, where Jehoshaphat held towns that Asa had taken (15:8; 17:2). The phrase reshapes the old "from Dan to Beersheba", which named all Israel, to fit the smaller kingdom of Judah.

decisions.choice: brought them back: led them to turn again to the LORD
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the same root as "returned" earlier in the verse. The king returns among the people and turns them back to the God their ancestors served; it is the language of repentance.

decisions.choice: in the far south; in the north; the God their ancestors had worshiped
decisions.reason: Readable adds where the two places lay so the reader can see that the whole land is meant, and turns "the God of their ancestors" into a clause.

decisions.choice: "volvió a salir ... los hizo volver"
decisions.reason: "Returned" and "brought back" share one root (meaning decision); Spanish keeps the play with "volver" in both places.

decisions.choice: voltou a sair ... os fez voltar (L); trouxe de volta (B); levou o povo a voltar (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of turning back to God comes from the same root as "returned" (m3); Portuguese "voltar" serves for both, so Literal keeps the echo ("voltou a sair", "os fez voltar") and Balanced and Readable keep "voltar" for the people's return to God, the language of repentance. "Pais" (L) and "antepassados" (B, R) as the formulas of Kings.

en.B: He appointed judges throughout the land, in all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city.

es.R: Puso jueces en todo el país, en cada una de las ciudades amuralladas de Judá.

fr.R: Il a placé des juges dans tout le pays, dans chacune des villes fortifiées de Juda.

vi.B: Vua lập các thẩm phán khắp trong xứ, tại tất cả các thành kiên cố của Giu-đa, từng thành một.
vi.R: Vua đặt các thẩm phán khắp trong xứ, tại mỗi thành có tường bao quanh của Giu-đa.

ko.B: 그는 온 땅, 곧 유다의 모든 요새 성읍마다 재판관들을 세웠다.
ko.R: 그는 온 땅에, 곧 성벽으로 둘러싸인 유다의 성읍마다 재판관들을 세웠다.

pt.B: Ele nomeou juízes por toda a terra, em todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá, cidade por cidade.
pt.R: Ele colocou juízes por toda a terra, em cada uma das cidades de Judá que tinham muralhas.

decisions.choice: judges: officials who heard cases and gave verdicts
decisions.reason: Here the word means judges in courts of law, not the leaders raised up to rescue Israel in the book of Judges. The king's own name, Jehoshaphat, means "Yahweh judges", and this chapter shows him putting justice in order.

decisions.choice: judges in every city: as the law commanded
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 16:18 told Israel to appoint judges and officials in all its towns. Jehoshaphat carries out that command.

decisions.choice: fortified cities: the walled towns that held the kingdom's garrisons
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat had stationed troops and officials in these cities (17:2, 19). They were centers of royal government, so courts were set up there.

decisions.choice: for city and city: in each city, one after another
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun is a Hebrew way to say "each" or "every".

decisions.choice: walled cities
decisions.reason: Readable says "walled" for "fortified", the plainer word for the same thing.

decisions.choice: "thẩm phán" for the judges
decisions.reason: The word of the Samuel and Kings drafts; the Joshua-Ruth drafts propose "quan xét", so a reviewer should settle one (uncertain).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־הַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה־אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כִּ֣י לֹ֧א לְאָדָ֛ם תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ כִּ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמָּכֶ֖ם בִּדְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to the judges: See what you [are] doing, for not for man you judge, but for Yahweh, and with you in [the] matter of judgment.

en.L: And he said to the judges, "Consider what you [are] doing, for you do not judge for man but for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] with you in the matter of judgment.
en.B: He said to the judges, "Think about what you are doing. You are not judging for human beings but for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is with you when you give a verdict.
en.R: He told the judges, "Be careful what you do. You are not judging for people. You are judging for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is with you whenever you decide a case.

es.L: Y dijo a los jueces: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} lo que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, porque no {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}} en lugar de hombre, sino en lugar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está] con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el asunto del juicio.
es.B: Les dijo a los jueces: «{{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} bien en lo que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}. No {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}} en nombre de los seres humanos, sino en nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{plural_you:dictan|dictáis}} sentencia.
es.R: Les dijo a los jueces: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con lo que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}. No {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}} para agradar a la gente. {{plural_you:Juzgan|Juzgáis}} en nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cada vez que {{plural_you:deciden|decidís}} un caso.

fr.L: Et il dit aux juges : « Voyez ce que vous faites, car ce n’est pas pour l’homme que vous jugez, mais pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] avec vous dans l’affaire du jugement.
fr.B: Il dit aux juges : « Pensez à ce que vous faites. Ce n’est pas pour des hommes que vous jugez, mais pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est avec vous quand vous rendez un jugement.
fr.R: Il a dit aux juges : « Faites attention à ce que vous faites. Vous ne jugez pas pour les gens. Vous jugez pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est avec vous chaque fois que vous décidez d’une affaire.

sw.L: Akawaambia waamuzi, "Angalieni mnachokifanya, kwa maana hamhukumu kwa ajili ya mwanadamu bali kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye [yuko] pamoja nanyi katika jambo la hukumu.
sw.B: Akawaambia waamuzi, "Fikirini mnachokifanya. Hamhukumu kwa ajili ya wanadamu bali kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye yuko pamoja nanyi mnapotoa hukumu.
sw.R: Akawaambia waamuzi, "Kuweni waangalifu katika mnachokifanya. Hamhukumu kwa ajili ya watu. Mnahukumu kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye yuko pamoja nanyi kila mnapoamua shauri.

vi.L: Vua nói với các thẩm phán: "Hãy xem xét điều các ngươi [đang] làm, vì các ngươi không xét xử cho loài người mà cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở] với các ngươi trong việc xét xử.
vi.B: Vua nói với các thẩm phán: "Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ điều các ngươi làm. Các ngươi không xét xử cho loài người mà cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở với các ngươi khi các ngươi phán quyết.
vi.R: Vua bảo các thẩm phán: "Hãy cẩn thận trong mọi việc các ngươi làm. Các ngươi không xét xử cho con người. Các ngươi xét xử cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở với các ngươi mỗi khi các ngươi xử một vụ án.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 재판관들에게 말했다. "너희가 하는 일을 살펴라. 너희는 사람을 위하여 재판하는 것이 아니라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 재판하는 것이다. 그리고 재판하는 일에 [그분께서] 너희와 함께 [계신다].
ko.B: 그는 재판관들에게 말했다. "너희가 하는 일을 잘 생각하여라. 너희는 사람을 위하여 재판하는 것이 아니라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 재판하는 것이다. 너희가 판결을 내릴 때 그분께서 너희와 함께 계신다.
ko.R: 그는 재판관들에게 말했다. "너희가 하는 일을 조심하여라. 너희는 사람을 위하여 재판하는 것이 아니다. 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 재판하는 것이다. 너희가 재판할 때마다 그분께서 너희와 함께 계신다.

pt.L: E disse aos juízes: "Vejam o que vocês [estão] fazendo, pois não é para o homem que vocês julgam, mas para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está] com vocês na questão do julgamento.
pt.B: Ele disse aos juízes: "Pensem no que vocês estão fazendo. Vocês não julgam em nome de seres humanos, mas em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está com vocês quando vocês dão a sentença.
pt.R: Ele disse aos juízes: "Tenham cuidado com o que fazem. Vocês não julgam em nome das pessoas. Vocês julgam em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está com vocês sempre que decidem um caso.

decisions.choice: not for man but for the LORD: judges act on the LORD's behalf and answer to him
decisions.reason: A judge's verdict is not given to please people or the king. It is given in the LORD's place and must match his justice, as Deuteronomy 1:17 says: "the judgment belongs to God".

decisions.choice: and he is with you in the matter of judgment
alternatives: and the decision rests with you
decisions.reason: The clause has no verb or subject. The nearest subject is the LORD: he is present with the judges when they give judgment, both to help them and to see what they do. It could also mean "and the matter of judgment is with you", that is, the decision rests in your hands.

decisions.choice: he is
decisions.reason: English needs a subject and a verb. Literal brackets them; Balanced and Readable supply them as the LORD's presence (see the meaning note).

decisions.choice: human beings, people; give a verdict, decide a case
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "man" here means human beings in general, so Balanced and Readable use words that include everyone. "The matter of judgment" is the giving of a verdict in a case.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans through Jehoshaphat's charge to the judges (verses 6-11)
decisions.reason: The king speaks to all the judges, so every "you" is plural and takes the plural_you span, verbs and clitics included.

decisions.choice: angalieni; hamhukumu; nanyi (plural forms)
decisions.reason: The king speaks to all the judges (verses 6-11); Swahili marks the plural "you" in the verbs and pronouns, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: the king says "các ngươi" to the judges
decisions.reason: A king giving a charge to his officials, as Solomon and Rehoboam do in these books; "loài người" (L, B), "con người" (R) already include everyone.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to his judges in 해라체 with "너희"
decisions.reason: Kings speak to subjects in 해라체, as in the Korean Kings.

decisions.choice: julgar em nome de (B, R); julgar para (L)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "julgar para alguém" is not a natural phrase; the judges act on the LORD's behalf and answer to him (m1), which "em nome de" says plainly, as Deuteronomy 1:17 in Portuguese has "julgando em nome de Deus" at Readable. "Seres humanos" and "as pessoas" already include everyone, so no gender span is needed.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד־יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ כִּֽי־אֵ֞ין עִם־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַוְלָ֛ה וּמַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּמִקַּח־שֹֽׁחַד׃

records.literal_gloss: And now let be [the] dread of Yahweh upon you; keep and do, for there is not with Yahweh our God injustice, and lifting of faces, and taking of a bribe.

en.L: And now, let the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be upon you. Be careful and act, for with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God there is no injustice, nor lifting up of faces, nor taking of a bribe."
en.B: So now, let the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be upon you. Be careful in what you do, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God does no wrong, plays no favorites and takes no bribe."
en.R: Now let the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} guide you. Be careful in what you do. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God is never unfair. He treats everyone the same, and no one can pay {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to change what is right."

es.L: Y ahora, sea el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; {{plural_you:guarden y hagan|guardad y haced}}, porque con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios no hay injusticia, ni acepción de personas, ni recibir soborno».
es.B: Así que ahora, que el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} esté sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con lo que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios no hace injusticia, no tiene favoritos ni acepta soborno».
es.R: Ahora, que el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los guíe|os guíe}}. {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con lo que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nunca es injusto. Trata a todos por igual, y nadie puede pagarle para que cambie lo que es justo».

fr.L: Et maintenant, que la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} soit sur vous. Prenez garde et agissez, car il n’y a chez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ni injustice, ni égard pour l’apparence des personnes, ni acceptation de pot-de-vin. »
fr.B: Maintenant donc, que la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} soit sur vous. Faites attention à ce que vous faites, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ne commet pas d’injustice, ne fait pas de favoritisme et n’accepte pas de pot-de-vin. »
fr.R: Maintenant, que la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vous guide. Faites attention à ce que vous faites. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu n’est jamais injuste. Il traite tout le monde de la même façon, et personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} payer pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} change ce qui est juste. »

sw.L: Basi sasa, hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na iwe juu yenu. Jihadharini na kutenda, kwa maana kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu hakuna udhalimu, wala upendeleo wa nyuso, wala kupokea rushwa."
sw.B: Basi sasa, hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na iwe juu yenu. Kuweni waangalifu katika mnachokifanya, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu hatendi uovu, hana upendeleo, wala hapokei rushwa."
sw.R: Sasa hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na iwaongoze. Kuweni waangalifu katika mnachokifanya. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kamwe si dhalimu. Huwatendea watu wote sawa, wala hakuna mtu awezaye kumhonga ili abadilishe yaliyo haki."

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, hãy để sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên các ngươi. Hãy cẩn thận mà làm, vì nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta không có sự bất công, không có sự thiên vị, không có sự nhận hối lộ."
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy để sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên các ngươi. Hãy cẩn thận trong việc mình làm, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta không làm điều bất công, không thiên vị ai và không nhận hối lộ."
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy để lòng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hướng dẫn các ngươi. Hãy cẩn thận trong việc mình làm. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta không bao giờ bất công. Ngài đối xử với mọi người như nhau, và không ai có thể đút lót {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để làm sai lẽ phải."

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하는 마음이 너희 위에 있게 하여라. 조심하여 행하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께는 불의도 없고, 사람의 얼굴을 보는 일도 없고, 뇌물을 받는 일도 없다."
ko.B: 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하는 마음으로 일하여라. 조심하여 행하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께서는 불의한 일을 하지 않으시고, 사람을 차별하지 않으시며, 뇌물을 받지 않으신다."
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하는 마음으로 일하여라. 무엇을 하든지 조심하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께서는 결코 불공평하지 않으시다. 그분께서는 모든 사람을 똑같이 대하시고, 아무도 그분께 돈을 주고 옳은 것을 바꾸게 할 수 없다."

pt.L: E agora, que o temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} esteja sobre vocês. Tenham cuidado e ajam, porque com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, não há injustiça, nem erguer o rosto [de ninguém], nem aceitar suborno."
pt.B: Agora, então, que o temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} esteja sobre vocês. Tenham cuidado com o que fazem, pois não há injustiça {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o nosso Deus, nem parcialidade, nem suborno."
pt.R: Agora deixem que o temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} guie vocês. Tenham cuidado com o que fazem. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, nunca é injusto. Ele trata todos da mesma forma, e ninguém consegue comprá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} com dinheiro para que mude o que é justo."

decisions.choice: the fear of the LORD: awe of the LORD that keeps one from wrongdoing
decisions.reason: The word means dread or deep awe. Judges who know that the LORD sees them will be afraid to give an unjust verdict. Verse 9 uses another word for the same fear.

decisions.choice: keep and act: act with care
decisions.reason: Two commands joined together make one: watch carefully what you do.

decisions.choice: lifting of faces: showing favor to someone because of who they are
decisions.reason: To "lift someone's face" was to accept and favor that person. In a court it means judging by who a person is rather than by the facts, as in Deuteronomy 10:17 and 16:19.

decisions.choice: no injustice, no partiality, no bribe-taking with the LORD
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat echoes Deuteronomy 10:17, where the LORD "does not lift up a face and does not take a bribe", and the command to judges in Deuteronomy 16:19 (Exodus 23:8). Because God himself judges this way, those who judge for him must do the same.

decisions.choice: does no wrong, plays no favorites and takes no bribe (Balanced); treats everyone the same, and no one can pay him to change what is right (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording follows Deuteronomy 10:17 at each level, so the echo can be heard. Balanced and Readable turn the nouns into things the LORD does or does not do.

decisions.choice: guide you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "let the fear of the LORD be upon you" as letting that fear guide what the judges do.

decisions.choice: "acepción de personas" (L); "no tiene favoritos" (B); "trata a todos por igual" (R)
decisions.reason: Lifting the face is showing favor (meaning decision); Literal uses the established Spanish phrase for partiality, and Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: "égard pour l'apparence des personnes" (L); "favoritisme" (B); "traite tout le monde de la même façon" (R)
decisions.reason: "Lifting of faces" (m3) is kept as a picture at Literal in plain French, where the old "acception de personnes" is no longer understood; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: upendeleo wa nyuso (Literal); hana upendeleo (Balanced); huwatendea watu wote sawa (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Lifting up faces" is showing favor; Literal keeps the faces in the phrase, Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "sự thiên vị" (L), "thiên vị" (B), "đối xử với mọi người như nhau" (R) for "lifting of faces"
decisions.reason: Showing favor because of who someone is (m3); Vietnamese says it plainly at every level, as the published Deuteronomy 10:17.

decisions.choice: "사람의 얼굴을 보는 일" (L), "사람을 차별하지" (B), "모든 사람을 똑같이 대하시고" (R)
decisions.reason: "Lifting of faces" is showing favor (m3); Literal keeps the image, Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: nem erguer o rosto [de ninguém], nem aceitar suborno (L); nem parcialidade, nem suborno (B); the Readable of Deuteronomy 10:17 word for word (R)
alternatives: não favorece ninguém e não se deixa comprar com suborno (B)
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat echoes Deuteronomy 10:17 (m4). Literal keeps that verse's Portuguese picture, "erguer o rosto [de ninguém]", and its "aceitar suborno"; Readable repeats its Readable sentence exactly, as the English does. Balanced keeps the Hebrew's three nouns in a short list, "injustiça ... parcialidade ... suborno", where the English turns them into verbs: the nouns are clear in Portuguese and make a sentence a judge can remember. "O temor do SENHOR" for the dread of verse 7 and the fear of verse 9 alike (m1).

source.text: וְגַ֣ם בִּ֠ירוּשָׁלִַם הֶעֱמִ֨יד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּמֵרָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְלָרִ֑יב וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And also in Jerusalem appointed Jehoshaphat from the Levites and the priests and from [the] heads of the fathers of Israel for [the] judgment of Yahweh and for dispute; and they returned [to] Jerusalem.

en.L: And also in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites and the priests and some of the heads of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and for disputes. And they returned to Jerusalem.
en.B: In Jerusalem also Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites and priests and some of the heads of Israel's families, to give judgment for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to settle disputes. And they returned to Jerusalem.
en.R: Jehoshaphat also chose some of the Levites, the priests and the leaders of Israel's families to serve as judges in Jerusalem. They were to decide cases about {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s law and settle quarrels between people. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y también en Jerusalén puso Josafat a algunos de los levitas y de los sacerdotes y de los jefes de las casas paternas de Israel, para el juicio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para los pleitos. Y volvieron a Jerusalén.
es.B: También en Jerusalén Josafat nombró a algunos de los levitas y de los sacerdotes y de los jefes de familia de Israel, para juzgar en nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para resolver pleitos. Y volvieron a Jerusalén.
es.R: Josafat también escogió a algunos de los levitas, de los sacerdotes y de los jefes de las familias de Israel para que fueran jueces en Jerusalén. Debían decidir los casos sobre la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y resolver los pleitos entre la gente. Luego volvieron a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et à Jérusalem aussi, Josaphat établit [quelques-uns] des Lévites et des prêtres et des chefs des pères d’Israël pour le jugement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et pour les contestations. Et ils revinrent à Jérusalem.
fr.B: À Jérusalem aussi, Josaphat établit des Lévites, des prêtres et des chefs de famille d’Israël, pour rendre la justice au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et régler les différends. Et ils revinrent à Jérusalem.
fr.R: À Jérusalem aussi, Josaphat a choisi des Lévites, des prêtres et des chefs des familles d’Israël pour servir de juges. Ils devaient décider des affaires qui concernaient la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et régler les disputes entre les gens. Puis ils sont rentrés à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Tena katika Yerusalemu Yehoshafati akaweka baadhi ya Walawi na makuhani na baadhi ya wakuu wa mababa wa Israeli, kwa ajili ya hukumu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwa ajili ya mashauri. Nao wakarudi Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Katika Yerusalemu pia Yehoshafati aliweka baadhi ya Walawi na makuhani na baadhi ya wakuu wa jamaa za Israeli, ili watoe hukumu kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuamua mashauri. Nao wakarudi Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yehoshafati aliwachagua pia baadhi ya Walawi, makuhani na viongozi wa jamaa za Israeli ili wawe waamuzi huko Yerusalemu. Walipaswa kuamua mashauri yanayohusu sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kusuluhisha ugomvi kati ya watu. Kisha wakarudi Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giô-sa-phát cũng lập một số người Lê-vi, thầy tế lễ và một số trưởng tộc của Y-sơ-ra-ên, để xét xử cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và để giải quyết các vụ tranh tụng. Rồi họ trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giô-sa-phát cũng lập một số người Lê-vi, thầy tế lễ và một số trưởng gia tộc của Y-sơ-ra-ên, để xét xử theo luật của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giải quyết các vụ tranh chấp. Rồi họ trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát cũng chọn một số người Lê-vi, thầy tế lễ và những người đứng đầu các gia đình Y-sơ-ra-ên làm thẩm phán tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ phải xét xử các vụ việc liên quan đến luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giải quyết những vụ cãi cọ giữa người với người. Rồi họ trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 예루살렘에서도 여호사밧이 레위인들과 제사장들과 이스라엘 가문의 우두머리들 가운데 몇을 세워 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 재판과 소송을 맡게 했다. 그리고 그들이 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다.
ko.B: 예루살렘에서도 여호사밧은 레위인과 제사장과 이스라엘 가문의 우두머리 가운데 몇 사람을 세워, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 재판하고 소송을 판결하게 했다. 그리고 그들은 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 예루살렘에서도 레위인과 제사장과 이스라엘 각 집안의 지도자 가운데 몇 사람을 뽑아 재판관으로 세웠다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법에 관한 일을 판결하고, 사람들 사이의 다툼을 해결해야 했다. 그 뒤에 그들은 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다.

pt.L: E também em Jerusalém Josafá estabeleceu [alguns] dos levitas e dos sacerdotes e dos chefes das famílias de Israel, para o juízo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e para as disputas. E voltaram a Jerusalém.
pt.B: Também em Jerusalém Josafá nomeou alguns dos levitas, dos sacerdotes e dos chefes das famílias de Israel, para julgar em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e resolver as disputas. E eles voltaram para Jerusalém.
pt.R: Josafá também escolheu alguns dos levitas, dos sacerdotes e dos líderes das famílias de Israel para servirem como juízes em Jerusalém. Eles deviam decidir os casos ligados à lei {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e resolver as brigas entre as pessoas. Depois eles voltaram para Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: a court in Jerusalem of priests, Levites and family heads
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 17:8-12 tells Israel to take cases too hard for the local judges to the priests, the Levites and the judge at the place the LORD would choose. Jehoshaphat sets up such a court in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: the judgment of the LORD and disputes: cases under God's law and quarrels between people
alternatives: all cases, named in two ways
decisions.reason: The two phrases seem to divide the work, as verse 11 does with "every matter of the LORD" and "every matter of the king": questions about the LORD's commands and worship on one side, and ordinary disputes between people on the other. They may also be two ways of naming all the cases the court heard.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers: leaders of Israel's family groups
decisions.reason: "The house of the fathers" was the extended family, and its heads were the senior men who led it. They often judged among their people.

decisions.choice: and they returned to Jerusalem
alternatives: for those who lived in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Hebrew as pointed reads "and they returned to Jerusalem", which may mean that Jehoshaphat and his party came back from the journey of verse 4. The same consonants can be read "and they lived in Jerusalem", and the Greek translation has "to judge those who live in Jerusalem", which suits the verse better but needs a different text. The Hebrew as written is kept.

decisions.choice: to serve as judges; cases about the LORD's law; quarrels between people
decisions.reason: Readable makes the court's two tasks explicit. "The LORD's law" interprets "the judgment of the LORD"; see the meaning note.

decisions.choice: "jefes de las casas paternas" (L); "jefes de familia" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:2: the heads of the fathers are the heads of family lines.

decisions.choice: os chefes das famílias (L, B); os líderes das famílias (R)
decisions.reason: As 1:2 sets the "heads of the fathers" (m3) for the book: "famílias" at every level, since a word-for-word "chefes dos pais" would mean heads of parents.

source.text: וַיְצַ֥ו עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּן֙ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בֶּאֱמוּנָ֖ה וּבְלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he commanded them, saying: Thus you shall do, in [the] fear of Yahweh, in faithfulness, and with a heart whole.

en.L: And he commanded them, saying, "Thus you shall do: in the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in faithfulness, and with a whole heart.
en.B: He gave them this charge: "This is how you must act: in the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, faithfully, and with an undivided heart.
en.R: He gave them these orders: "Do your work with fear and respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Be faithful, and do it with all your heart.

es.L: Y les mandó, diciendo: «Así {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}: en el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, con fidelidad y con corazón íntegro.
es.B: Les dio este encargo: «Así es como {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} actuar: en el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, con fidelidad y con un corazón íntegro.
es.R: Les dio estas órdenes: «{{plural_you:Hagan su|Haced vuestro}} trabajo con temor y respeto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} fieles, y {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} de todo corazón.

fr.L: Et il leur ordonna en disant : « Ainsi vous ferez, dans la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, avec fidélité et d’un cœur entier.
fr.B: Il leur donna cet ordre : « Voici comment vous devez agir : dans la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, avec fidélité et d’un cœur sans partage.
fr.R: Il leur a donné ces ordres : « Faites votre travail avec crainte et respect pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Soyez fidèles, et faites-le de tout votre cœur.

sw.L: Akawaagiza, akisema, "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya: katika hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa uaminifu, na kwa moyo mkamilifu.
sw.B: Akawapa agizo hili: "Hivi ndivyo mnavyopaswa kutenda: katika hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa uaminifu, na kwa moyo usiogawanyika.
sw.R: Akawapa maagizo haya: "Fanyeni kazi yenu kwa kumcha na kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kuweni waaminifu, na kuifanya kwa moyo wenu wote.

vi.L: Vua truyền lệnh cho họ rằng: "Các ngươi phải làm như vầy: trong sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong sự trung tín, và với tấm lòng trọn vẹn.
vi.B: Vua căn dặn họ: "Các ngươi phải làm việc như thế này: kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trung tín, và với tấm lòng trọn vẹn.
vi.R: Vua ra lệnh cho họ: "Hãy làm việc với lòng kính sợ và tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy trung tín và làm hết lòng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 명령하여 말했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하며 신실하게 온전한 마음으로 이렇게 행하여라.
ko.B: 그는 그들에게 이렇게 명령했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하는 마음으로, 신실하게, 온전한 마음으로 일하여라.
ko.R: 그는 그들에게 이렇게 명령했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하고 존경하는 마음으로 일하여라. 신실하게, 온 마음을 다해 일하여라.

pt.L: E lhes deu ordens, dizendo: "Assim vocês farão: no temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, com fidelidade e com coração íntegro.
pt.B: Ele lhes deu esta ordem: "Vocês devem agir assim: no temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, com fidelidade e com o coração íntegro.
pt.R: Ele lhes deu estas ordens: "Façam o seu trabalho com temor e respeito {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}. Sejam fiéis e trabalhem de todo o coração.

decisions.choice: the fear of the LORD: reverence for the LORD that shapes how one acts
decisions.reason: This is the usual word for the fear of the LORD, the awe and reverence that lead to obedience. It repeats the point of verse 7.

decisions.choice: faithfulness: being reliable and honest
decisions.reason: The word describes someone who can be trusted, who is true to his duty and to the truth.

decisions.choice: with a whole heart: with undivided loyalty
decisions.reason: A "whole" or "complete" heart is wholly given to the LORD, with no divided loyalty (1 Chronicles 28:9; 29:9, 19). For judges it means integrity: no hidden purposes behind their verdicts.

decisions.choice: fear and respect; with all your heart
decisions.reason: Readable adds "respect" so the fear is not mistaken for terror, and uses the common phrase "with all your heart".

decisions.choice: com coração íntegro (L), com o coração íntegro (B); de todo o coração (R)
decisions.reason: The undivided heart (m3) keeps the words 1 Chronicles 28:9 has in Portuguese at each level, the verse the meaning note names; "íntegro" also says the integrity a judge needs.

source.text: וְכָל־רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֣ם׀הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֗ם בֵּֽין־דָּ֣ם׀לְדָם֮ בֵּין־תּוֹרָ֣ה לְמִצְוָה֮ לְחֻקִּ֣ים וּלְמִשְׁפָּטִים֒ וְהִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־קֶ֥צֶף עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְעַל־אֲחֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן וְלֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And every dispute which comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, and you shall warn them, and not they will be guilty to Yahweh, and will be wrath upon you and upon your brothers; thus you shall do, and not you will be guilty.

en.L: And every dispute that comes to you from your brothers who live in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, you shall warn them, so that they do not become guilty before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and wrath come upon you and upon your brothers. Thus you shall do, and you will not become guilty.
en.B: Whenever a case comes to you from your {{gender:fellow Israelites|brothers}} who live in their cities, whether it concerns bloodshed, or law and commandment, statutes and rulings, you must warn them, so that they do not incur guilt before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and wrath fall on you and your {{gender:fellow Israelites|brothers}}. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.
en.R: Cases will come to you from your {{gender:fellow Israelites|brothers}} who live in the towns. They may be about someone who was killed, or about God's teaching, commands, laws and rules. In every case, warn them not to sin against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Otherwise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be angry with you and with them. If you do this, you will not be guilty.

es.L: Y en todo pleito que venga a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos que habitan en sus ciudades, entre sangre y sangre, entre ley y mandamiento, estatutos y decretos, {{plural_you:les advertirán|les advertiréis}}, para que no se hagan culpables ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y venga la ira sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y sobre {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos. Así {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}, y no {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} culpables.
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:les|os}} llegue un caso de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos que viven en sus ciudades, ya sea de derramamiento de sangre, o de ley y mandamiento, estatutos y decretos, {{plural_you:deben advertirles|debéis advertirles}} que no se hagan culpables ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para que no caiga la ira sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y sobre {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} esto, y no {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} culpables.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} llegarán casos de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} compatriotas que viven en las ciudades. Podrán tratar de alguien que fue muerto, o de la enseñanza de Dios, sus mandamientos, leyes y normas. En cada caso, {{plural_you:adviértanles|advertidles}} que no pequen contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. De lo contrario, {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y con ellos. Si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} esto, no {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} culpables.

fr.L: Et toute contestation qui viendra devant vous de la part de vos frères qui habitent dans leurs villes, entre sang et sang, entre loi et commandement, prescriptions et jugements, vous les avertirez, afin qu’ils ne se rendent pas coupables envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et que la colère ne vienne pas sur vous et sur vos frères. Ainsi vous ferez, et vous ne serez pas coupables.
fr.B: Chaque fois qu’une affaire vous sera soumise par vos {{gender:compatriotes|frères}} qui habitent dans leurs villes, qu’il s’agisse d’un meurtre, ou de loi et de commandement, de prescriptions et de règles, vous devrez les avertir, pour qu’ils ne se rendent pas coupables envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et que la colère ne tombe pas sur vous et sur vos {{gender:compatriotes|frères}}. Faites cela, et vous ne serez pas coupables.
fr.R: Des affaires vous seront soumises par vos {{gender:compatriotes|frères}} qui habitent dans les villes. Il peut s’agir de quelqu’un qui a été tué, ou de l’enseignement de Dieu, de ses commandements, de ses lois et de ses règles. Dans chaque cas, avertissez-les de ne pas pécher contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Sinon, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera en colère contre vous et contre eux. Si vous faites cela, vous ne serez pas coupables.

sw.L: Na kila shauri litakalowajia kutoka kwa ndugu zenu wanaokaa katika miji yao, kati ya damu na damu, kati ya sheria na amri, kanuni na hukumu, mtawaonya ili wasiwe na hatia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ghadhabu ikaja juu yenu na juu ya ndugu zenu. Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya, nanyi hamtakuwa na hatia.
sw.B: Kila shauri litakapowajia kutoka kwa ndugu zenu wanaoishi katika miji yao, likiwa ni la umwagaji damu, au la sheria na amri, kanuni na maamuzi, mnapaswa kuwaonya wasije wakawa na hatia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ghadhabu ikawajia ninyi na ndugu zenu. Fanyeni hivyo, nanyi hamtakuwa na hatia.
sw.R: Mashauri yatawajia kutoka kwa ndugu zenu wanaoishi mijini. Huenda yakahusu mtu aliyeuawa, au mafundisho ya Mungu, amri, sheria na kanuni zake. Katika kila shauri, waonyeni wasimkosee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. La sivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawakasirikia ninyi na wao. Mkifanya hivyo, hamtakuwa na hatia.

vi.L: Mọi vụ tranh tụng đến với các ngươi từ anh em các ngươi sống trong các thành của họ, giữa máu và máu, giữa luật pháp và điều răn, luật lệ và phán quyết, các ngươi phải cảnh cáo họ, để họ không mắc tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và cơn thịnh nộ không đến trên các ngươi và trên anh em các ngươi. Hãy làm như vậy thì các ngươi sẽ không mắc tội.
vi.B: Mỗi khi có vụ việc từ đồng bào các ngươi sống trong các thành đưa đến cho các ngươi, dù liên quan đến án mạng, hay đến luật pháp và điều răn, luật lệ và phán quyết, các ngươi phải cảnh cáo họ, để họ không mắc tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cơn thịnh nộ không giáng trên các ngươi và trên đồng bào các ngươi. Hãy làm như vậy thì các ngươi sẽ không mắc tội.
vi.R: Đồng bào các ngươi sống trong các thành sẽ đưa đến cho các ngươi nhiều vụ việc. Có thể là vụ có người bị giết, hoặc vụ liên quan đến lời dạy, mệnh lệnh, luật lệ và quy định của Đức Chúa Trời. Trong mọi vụ việc, hãy cảnh cáo họ đừng phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nếu không, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giận các ngươi và giận họ. Nếu các ngươi làm như vậy, các ngươi sẽ không mắc tội.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 성읍들에 사는 너희 형제들에게서 너희에게 오는 모든 소송, 곧 피와 피 사이, 율법과 계명과 규례와 법도 사이의 [소송에서], 너희는 그들에게 경고하여 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 짓지 않게 하고, 진노가 너희와 너희 형제들 위에 임하지 않게 하여라. 이렇게 행하면 너희가 죄를 짓지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 성읍들에 사는 너희 {{gender:동족|형제}}들이 너희에게 가져오는 모든 소송이 피 흘린 일이든 율법과 계명과 규례와 법도에 관한 일이든, 너희는 그들에게 경고하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 짓지 않게 하여라. 그렇지 않으면 진노가 너희와 너희 {{gender:동족|형제}}들에게 임할 것이다. 이렇게 하면 너희가 죄를 짓지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 성읍들에 사는 너희 {{gender:동족|형제}}들이 너희에게 소송을 가져올 것이다. 사람이 죽은 일일 수도 있고, 하나님의 가르침과 계명과 법과 규칙에 관한 일일 수도 있다. 어떤 일이든 그들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 짓지 말라고 경고하여라. 그렇지 않으면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 그들에게 노하실 것이다. 이렇게 하면 너희는 죄가 없을 것이다.

pt.L: E toda disputa que chegar a vocês da parte dos irmãos de vocês que habitam nas suas cidades, entre sangue e sangue, entre lei e mandamento, estatutos e ordenanças, vocês os advertirão, para que não se tornem culpados diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e [não] venha ira sobre vocês e sobre os irmãos de vocês. Assim vocês farão, e não se tornarão culpados.
pt.B: Sempre que um caso chegar a vocês da parte dos {{gender:seus compatriotas|seus irmãos}} que vivem nas cidades deles, seja de derramamento de sangue, seja de lei e mandamento, estatutos e ordenanças, vocês devem adverti-los, para que não se tornem culpados diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e a ira não caia sobre vocês e sobre os {{gender:seus compatriotas|seus irmãos}}. Façam isso, e vocês não serão culpados.
pt.R: Os casos chegarão a vocês da parte dos {{gender:seus compatriotas|seus irmãos}} que moram nas cidades. Eles podem ser sobre alguém que foi morto, ou sobre os ensinamentos, os mandamentos, as leis e as regras de Deus. Em cada caso, advirtam essas pessoas para não pecarem contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Senão {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ficará irado com vocês e com elas. Se vocês fizerem isso, não serão culpados.

decisions.choice: between blood and blood: cases that involve a death
decisions.reason: The same phrase in Deuteronomy 17:8 names cases where someone has been killed, where the court must decide between one kind of killing and another, such as murder and accidental death (Numbers 35:9-34).

decisions.choice: law, commandment, statutes, judgments: questions about what God's law requires
decisions.reason: The four words together cover the whole of God's law, its teaching and its particular commands and rulings. Cases of this kind asked how the law applied.

decisions.choice: warn them, so that they do not become guilty and wrath come
decisions.reason: The judges must teach and warn the people who bring cases, so that they do not sin against the LORD. If the judges fail, wrath will come on the judges as well as the people. The last part, "thus you shall do, and you will not become guilty", says that faithful judges keep themselves free of that guilt.

decisions.choice: your brothers: your fellow Israelites
decisions.reason: "Brothers" means members of the same people, the Israelites of Judah's towns, men and women who bring cases to the court.

decisions.choice: fellow Israelites
decisions.reason: The word means all the people, so Balanced and Readable use the gender setting, as Deuteronomy 1:16 does.

decisions.choice: bloodshed (Balanced), someone who was killed (Readable); God's teaching, commands, laws and rules (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced follows Deuteronomy 17:8 for "blood and blood". Readable uses the settled plain words for the law terms and adds "God's" to show whose law is meant; it also names the LORD as the one who would be angry, as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "hermanos" (L, B); "compatriotas" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "fellow Israelites" against "brothers"; Spanish "hermanos" in the plural and "compatriotas" already take in women, so there is no second wording.

decisions.choice: "entre sangre y sangre" (L); "derramamiento de sangre" (B); "alguien que fue muerto" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase names cases where someone has been killed (meaning decision), as Deuteronomy 17:8.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:compatriotes|frères}}"
decisions.reason: "Your brothers" means fellow Israelites (m4); French offers "compatriotes" as the inclusive wording where the English has "fellow Israelites", as the French New Testament does for this sense, with "frères" as the traditional one; Literal keeps "frères", as the English Literal keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: ndugu zenu (no gender span)
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" covers brothers and sisters, fellow members of the people, so Swahili needs no gender span here where the English offers "fellow Israelites".

decisions.choice: "đồng bào" (B, R), no gender span
decisions.reason: "Brothers" means all one's fellow Israelites (m4); "đồng bào" already includes men and women, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart. Literal keeps "anh em".

decisions.choice: {{gender:동족|형제}}들 (B, R): "동족" (inclusive), "형제" (traditional)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable offer "fellow Israelites" and "brothers"; Korean "동족" covers men and women of one people, "형제" keeps the Hebrew word. Literal keeps "형제들", as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: os seus compatriotas (default); os seus irmãos (gender alternative)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 1:16 in Portuguese: "brothers" means fellow Israelites, women as well as men (m4), and "irmãos" would be read as family, so the default says "compatriotas" and the traditional "irmãos" is the alternative, where the English has "fellow Israelites" and "brothers". Literal keeps "irmãos", as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: entre sangue e sangue (L), derramamento de sangue (B); lei, mandamento, estatutos, ordenanças
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 17:8 in Portuguese for cases of bloodshed (m1), and the Old Testament terms for the four words of the law (m2): "estatuto" and "ordenança" for statute and rule.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ כֹהֵן֩ הָרֹ֨אשׁ עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־יְהוָ֗ה וּזְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַנָּגִ֤יד לְבֵית־יְהוּדָה֙ לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם חִזְק֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־הַטּֽוֹב׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And here, Amariah the chief priest [is] over you in every matter of Yahweh, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael the ruler of [the] house of Judah in every matter of the king, and [as] officials the Levites [are] before you. Be strong and act, and may be Yahweh with the good.

en.L: And see, Amariah the chief priest [is] over you in every matter of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in every matter of the king; and the Levites [are] officials before you. Be strong and act, and may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with the good."
en.B: Amariah the chief priest will be over you in every matter that concerns {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. In every matter that concerns the king, Zebadiah son of Ishmael, ruler of the house of Judah, will be over you. The Levites will serve you as officials. Act with courage, and may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with those who do good."
en.R: Amariah the chief priest will be in charge of you in every case that concerns {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be in charge in every case that concerns the king. The Levites will work for you as officials. Be brave and do your work. May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with those who do what is good."

es.L: Y he aquí, Amarías el sumo sacerdote [está] sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en todo asunto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y Zebadías hijo de Ismael, gobernante de la casa de Judá, en todo asunto del rey; y los levitas [son] oficiales delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Esfuércense y actúen|Esforzaos y actuad}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté con el bueno».
es.B: Amarías, el sumo sacerdote, estará al frente de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en todo asunto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. En todo asunto del rey estará al frente Zebadías hijo de Ismael, gobernante de la casa de Judá. Los levitas {{plural_you:les|os}} servirán como oficiales. {{plural_you:Actúen|Actuad}} con valor, y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté con los que hacen el bien».
es.R: Amarías, el sumo sacerdote, estará a cargo de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en todos los casos que tengan que ver con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Zebadías hijo de Ismael, el líder de la tribu de Judá, estará a cargo en todos los casos que tengan que ver con el rey. Los levitas {{plural_you:les|os}} servirán como oficiales. {{plural_you:Sean valientes y hagan su|Sed valientes y haced vuestro}} trabajo. Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté con los que hacen lo bueno».

fr.L: Et voici, Amaria, le prêtre en chef, [est] au-dessus de vous pour toute affaire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et Zebadia fils d’Ismaël, le chef de la maison de Juda, pour toute affaire du roi ; et les Lévites [sont] devant vous comme officiers. Soyez forts et agissez, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec celui qui est bon ! »
fr.B: Amaria, le prêtre en chef, vous dirigera dans toute affaire qui concerne {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Dans toute affaire qui concerne le roi, c’est Zebadia, fils d’Ismaël, chef de la maison de Juda, qui vous dirigera. Les Lévites seront à votre service comme officiers. Agissez avec courage, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec ceux qui font le bien ! »
fr.R: Amaria, le prêtre en chef, sera responsable de vous dans toutes les affaires qui concernent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Zebadia, fils d’Ismaël, le chef de la tribu de Juda, sera responsable dans toutes les affaires qui concernent le roi. Les Lévites travailleront pour vous comme officiers. Soyez courageux et faites votre travail. Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec ceux qui font ce qui est bien ! »

sw.L: Na tazama, Amaria kuhani mkuu [yuko] juu yenu katika kila jambo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na Zebadia mwana wa Ishmaeli, kiongozi wa nyumba ya Yuda, katika kila jambo la mfalme; na Walawi [ni] maafisa mbele yenu. Iweni hodari na kutenda, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awe pamoja na mwema."
sw.B: Amaria kuhani mkuu atakuwa juu yenu katika kila jambo linalomhusu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Katika kila jambo linalomhusu mfalme, Zebadia mwana wa Ishmaeli, kiongozi wa nyumba ya Yuda, atakuwa juu yenu. Walawi watawatumikia kama maafisa. Tendeni kwa ujasiri, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awe pamoja na wale watendao mema."
sw.R: Amaria kuhani mkuu atawasimamia katika kila shauri linalomhusu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Zebadia mwana wa Ishmaeli, kiongozi wa kabila la Yuda, atawasimamia katika kila shauri linalomhusu mfalme. Walawi watawafanyia kazi kama maafisa. Kuweni hodari na mfanye kazi yenu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja na wale wanaotenda yaliyo mema."

vi.L: Kìa, A-ma-ria, thầy tế lễ cả, [đứng] trên các ngươi trong mọi việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và Xê-ba-đia con trai Ích-ma-ên, người lãnh đạo nhà Giu-đa, trong mọi việc của vua; và người Lê-vi [là] các viên chức trước mặt các ngươi. Hãy mạnh mẽ mà làm, và nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với người tốt lành."
vi.B: A-ma-ria, thầy tế lễ cả, sẽ đứng đầu các ngươi trong mọi việc liên quan đến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Trong mọi việc liên quan đến vua, Xê-ba-đia con trai Ích-ma-ên, người lãnh đạo nhà Giu-đa, sẽ đứng đầu các ngươi. Người Lê-vi sẽ phục vụ các ngươi làm viên chức. Hãy can đảm mà làm, và nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với những người làm điều tốt lành."
vi.R: A-ma-ria, thầy tế lễ cả, sẽ phụ trách các ngươi trong mọi vụ việc liên quan đến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Xê-ba-đia con trai Ích-ma-ên, người lãnh đạo chi tộc Giu-đa, sẽ phụ trách trong mọi vụ việc liên quan đến vua. Người Lê-vi sẽ giúp các ngươi làm viên chức. Hãy can đảm làm tốt công việc. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với những người làm điều tốt lành."

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 대제사장 아마랴가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 일에 너희 위에 [있고], 유다 집의 지도자인 이스마엘의 아들 스바댜가 왕의 모든 일에 [너희 위에 있으며], 레위인들은 너희 앞에서 관리로 [있다]. 강하게 행하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 선한 자와 함께하시기를 바란다."
ko.B: 대제사장 아마랴가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 관한 모든 일에서 너희를 감독하고, 유다 집안의 지도자인 이스마엘의 아들 스바댜가 왕에 관한 모든 일에서 너희를 감독할 것이다. 레위인들은 너희를 돕는 관리로 일할 것이다. 용기를 내어 일하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 선한 일을 하는 사람들과 함께하시기를 바란다."
ko.R: 대제사장 아마랴는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 관한 모든 일을 맡아 너희를 이끌 것이다. 유다 지파의 지도자인 이스마엘의 아들 스바댜는 왕에 관한 모든 일을 맡을 것이다. 레위인들은 관리로서 너희를 도울 것이다. 용기를 내어 너희 일을 하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 선한 일을 하는 사람들과 함께하시기를 바란다."

pt.L: E eis que Amarias, o sacerdote-chefe, [está] sobre vocês em toda questão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e Zebadias, filho de Ismael, o príncipe da casa de Judá, em toda questão do rei; e os levitas [são] oficiais diante de vocês. Sejam fortes e ajam, e que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} esteja com o bom."
pt.B: Amarias, o sacerdote-chefe, estará acima de vocês em toda questão que diga respeito {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Em toda questão que diga respeito ao rei, Zebadias, filho de Ismael, príncipe da casa de Judá, estará acima de vocês. Os levitas servirão a vocês como oficiais. Ajam com coragem, e que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} esteja com os que fazem o bem."
pt.R: Amarias, o sumo sacerdote, ficará encarregado de vocês em todos os casos ligados {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Zebadias, filho de Ismael, o chefe da tribo de Judá, ficará encarregado de todos os casos ligados ao rei. Os levitas vão trabalhar para vocês como oficiais. Sejam corajosos e façam o seu trabalho. Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} esteja com quem faz o que é bom."

decisions.choice: matters of the LORD, matters of the king: religious cases and royal or civil cases
decisions.reason: The two officials divide the work. The chief priest decides questions about the LORD's law and worship; the leader of Judah decides matters that belong to the king, such as taxes, service and other royal affairs. 1 Chronicles 26:30, 32 divides duties in the same way.

decisions.choice: the ruler of the house of Judah: the leader of the tribe of Judah
decisions.reason: "Ruler" is the title used for a recognized leader; here it is the head of the tribe of Judah, a senior royal official.

decisions.choice: officials before you: Levites serving the judges as court officers
decisions.reason: The word is the one used in Deuteronomy 16:18 for officers who served alongside the judges, keeping records and carrying out decisions. "Before you" means at the judges' service.

decisions.choice: be strong and act, and may the LORD be with the good
alternatives: and the LORD will be with the good
decisions.reason: The first two commands mean "act with courage" (as 1 Chronicles 28:10). The last clause is most likely a wish or blessing; it can also be read as a promise, "the LORD will be with the good". "The good" means the one who does what is good, here the judge who acts justly.

decisions.choice: see (Literal); not translated (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens with a word that draws attention to what follows. Literal says "see"; Balanced and Readable let the sentence itself do that.

decisions.choice: leader of the tribe of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable uses "leader" for this title, as elsewhere in these books, and "tribe" for the "house" of Judah.

decisions.choice: "Amarías el sumo sacerdote"; "Zebadías hijo de Ismael"; "gobernante" (L, B), "líder" (R)
decisions.reason: The names take their usual Spanish forms; *nagid* follows the Samuel terms note for Spanish.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo" for *nagid*
decisions.reason: The word of the Samuel terms note at every level; "thầy tế lễ cả" for the chief priest, as the published Gospels.

decisions.choice: Amarias, o sacerdote-chefe (L, B), o sumo sacerdote (R); Zebadias, filho de Ismael; o príncipe (L, B), o chefe (R); oficiais
decisions.reason: The chief priest's title keeps the wording 2 Kings 25:18 has in Portuguese, "sacerdote-chefe" at Literal and Balanced and "sumo sacerdote" at Readable. The ruler's title (m2) is *nagid*, "príncipe" (L, B) and "chefe" (R) as in Samuel and Kings; the Levites are "oficiais" (m3), the word of Deuteronomy 16:18 and 1 Chronicles 23:4 in Portuguese. "Sejam fortes e ajam" turns 1 Chronicles 28:10's "Sê forte e age" to the plural (m4).
